intended_application: Summarize confidential client interviews and strategy reports, then send summaries directly to clients without analyst approval
business_need: Accelerate client reporting with minimal review
users_stakeholders: Analysts, project managers and eventual client recipients
capabilities_constraints: Two analysts; client names and nonpublic business information in inputs; provider retention/training-use/access terms unverified; proposed cross-client document retrieval and email connector; no security testing supplied
risk_consequence_context: Potential exposure of confidential information, cross-client disclosure, misleading client advice and reputational harm; external delivery is difficult to fully reverse
management_question: Which implementation red flags arise when the same LLM summarizer gains confidential inputs, cross-client retrieval and direct client delivery?
time_horizon: A six-week exploratory evaluation, not a production commitment
additional_context: Hypothetical contrast of the same consulting firm and LLM technology. No real client records are supplied. Several conditions change together, so this test does not isolate individual causal effects.
